name: Real Steel Manufacturing
old_description: We are an AWS certified welding facility, providing domestic and international service.
about:
Real Steel Manufacturing operates from Muskegon Heights, Michigan, as an AWS-certified welding facility serving both domestic and international customers. The company emphasizes welding and fabrication services performed to high quality standards.

Its capabilities span fabrication and welding, aluminum fabrication and welding, in-house machining of components and weldments, assembly, coating and finishing, media blasting, CNC laser and plasma cutting of sheet and plate, CNC sheet bending and plate bump-forming, post-weld heat treatment, and fixture design. The shop offers turn-key supply from raw material to finished, assembled product, handling small to medium welded assemblies that can ship in as little as one week, as well as large complex assemblies with tight tolerances and critical lead times.

The company's project history includes process vessels ranging from 14 ft by 48 in diameter to 8 ft by 24 in diameter with complex internal fixtures, and it has served clients such as Van Pelt Industries. Specific industry sectors are not detailed on the website.

Real Steel highlights speed and budget adherence as key differentiators, promoting fast turnaround and a single-source approach from material procurement through final coating.
